# AGENTS.override.md

Project-specific behavior changes that take precedence over AGENTS.md.

## Autogenerated Files

Ignore `*_templ.go` files during reviews and scans. The `templ` tool generates them from `.templ` sources. Review only the `.templ` file. Do not report lint, duplication, or style findings from generated output. Regenerate with `templ generate` after source edits.

## Demo Regeneration

After any `.templ` source edit, regenerate the demo page before delivering. Run from the project root:

```bash
templ generate && (cd docs && go run ../demo/*.go)
```

`docs/index.html` is the rendered demo served at ui.demo.goinfinite.net. A change that skips this step ships stale documentation.
